mapper.sql: SELECT r.game_id, r.system_key, r.option_key, source.name AS option_name, r.skill_key, s.name AS skill_name, s.status AS skill_status, r.activation_rank, r.skill_level_mode, r.fixed_skill_level, r.sort_order FROM public.build_option_skill_relations r JOIN public.build_options source ON source.game_id = r.game_id AND source.system_key = r.system_key AND source.option_key = r.option_key JOIN public.skills s ON s.game_id = r.game_id AND s.skill_key = r.skill_key WHERE r.game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.build_option_skill_relations (game_id, system_key, option_key, skill_key, activation_rank, skill_level_mode, fixed_skill_level, sort_order) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{systemKey}, #{optionKey}, #{skillKey}, #{activationRank}, #{skillLevelMode}, #{fixedSkillLevel}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (game_id, system_key, option_key, skill_key) DO NOTHING
